name: kl_convex_in_q
stmt:
theorem kl_convex_in_q (p q1 q2 : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq1 : ∀ a, 0 < q1 a) (hq2 : ∀ a, 0 < q2 a) {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    kl p (mixDist lam q1 q2) ≤ lam * kl p q1 + (1 - lam) * kl p q2
proof:
by
  have h := ce_convex_in_q p q1 q2 hp0 hq1 hq2 hlam0 hlam1
  have hsum1 : lam + (1 - lam) = 1 := by ring
  unfold kl
  linarith [h, hsum1]

name: mul_log_convex_two
stmt:
lemma mul_log_convex_two {x y q lam : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    (lam * x + (1 - lam) * y) * Real.log ((lam * x + (1 - lam) * y) / q)
      ≤ lam * (x * Real.log (x / q)) + (1 - lam) * (y * Real.log (y / q))
proof: mul_log_convex_pair hx hy hq hlam0 hlam1

name: kl_convex_in_p
stmt:
theorem kl_convex_in_p (p1 p2 q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp1 : ∀ a, 0 < p1 a) (hp2 : ∀ a, 0 < p2 a)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    kl (mixDist lam p1 p2) q ≤ lam * kl p1 q + (1 - lam) * kl p2 q
proof:
by
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_sub_log (mixDist lam p1 p2) q, kl_as_sum_log_sub_log p1 q,
    kl_as_sum_log_sub_log p2 q]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  have h1 := mul_log_convex_two (hp1 a) (hp2 a) (hq a) hlam0 hlam1
  have hmixpos : 0 < lam * p1 a + (1 - lam) * p2 a :=
    mixDist_pos p1 p2 hp1 hp2 hlam0 hlam1 a
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hp1 a)) (ne_of_gt (hq a)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hp2 a)) (ne_of_gt (hq a)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hmixpos) (ne_of_gt (hq a))] at h1
  simpa only [mixDist] using h1

end Lattice

name: logsum_finset
stmt:
lemma logsum_finset {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w x s : ι → ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hws : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) :
    (∑ i, w i * x i) * Real.log ((∑ i, w i * x i) / (∑ i, w i * s i))
      ≤ ∑ i, w i * (x i * Real.log (x i / s i))
proof:
by
  have hex : ∃ i, w i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ i, w i = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => h i)
    rw [hws] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0⟩ := hex
  have hwi0 : 0 < w i0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hw0 i0) (Ne.symm hi0)
  have hmpos : 0 < ∑ i, w i * x i :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hwi0 (hx i0))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt (hx i)))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0))
  have hrpos : 0 < ∑ i, w i * s i :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hwi0 (hs i0))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt (hs i)))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0))
  set m : ℝ := ∑ i, w i * x i with hm
  set r : ℝ := ∑ i, w i * s i with hr
  set A : ι → ℝ := fun i => x i * r / (s i * m) with hA
  have hApos : ∀ i, 0 < A i :=
    fun i => div_pos (mul_pos (hx i) hrpos) (mul_pos (hs i) hmpos)
  have hlogA : ∀ i, Real.log (A i)
      = (Real.log (x i) - Real.log (s i)) + (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : A i = (x i / s i) * (r / m) := by
      rw [hA]
      exact (div_mul_div_comm (x i) (s i) r m).symm
    rw [h1, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos (hx i) (hs i))) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hrpos hmpos)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hx i)) (ne_of_gt (hs i)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hrpos) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
  have hsplit : ∑ i, w i * (x i * Real.log (A i))
      = (∑ i, w i * (x i * Real.log (x i / s i))) + m * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    have hterm : ∀ i, w i * (x i * Real.log (A i))

name: logsum_two
doc:
两点 log-sum 不等式（逐项形式）：
m = lam·x + (1−lam)·y、r = lam·s + (1−lam)·t ⟹
m·log(m/r) ≤ lam·x·log(x/s) + (1−lam)·y·log(y/t)（x, y, s, t > 0、lam ∈ [0,1]）。
【实现】`logsum_finset` 在 `Fin 2` 上取权重 `(lam, 1−lam)`、点 `(x, y)`、`(s, t)`。
stmt:
lemma logsum_two {x y s t lam : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    (lam * x + (1 - lam) * y) * Real.log ((lam * x + (1 - lam) * y) / (lam * s + (1 - lam) * t))
      ≤ lam * (x * Real.log (x / s)) + (1 - lam) * (y * Real.log (y / t))
proof:
by
  have h := logsum_finset (w := ![lam, 1 - lam]) (x := ![x, y]) (s := ![s, t])
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> (simp; linarith [hlam0, hlam1]))
    (by simp [Fin.sum_univ_two])
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hx, hy])
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hs, ht])
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using h

name: kl_joint_convex
stmt:
theorem kl_joint_convex (p1 p2 q1 q2 : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp1 : ∀ a, 0 < p1 a) (hp2 : ∀ a, 0 < p2 a)
    (hq1 : ∀ a, 0 < q1 a) (hq2 : ∀ a, 0 < q2 a)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    kl (mixDist lam p1 p2) (mixDist lam q1 q2)
      ≤ lam * kl p1 q1 + (1 - lam) * kl p2 q2
proof:
by
  have hp : ∀ a, 0 < mixDist lam p1 p2 a := mixDist_pos p1 p2 hp1 hp2 hlam0 hlam1
  have hq : ∀ a, 0 < mixDist lam q1 q2 a := mixDist_pos q1 q2 hq1 hq2 hlam0 hlam1
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (mixDist lam p1 p2) (mixDist lam q1 q2) hp hq,
    kl_as_sum_log_ratio p1 q1 hp1 hq1, kl_as_sum_log_ratio p2 q2 hp2 hq2]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  have h := logsum_two (hp1 a) (hp2 a) (hq1 a) (hq2 a) hlam0 hlam1
  simpa only [mixDist] using h

name: kl_convex_in_p_strict_positive
stmt:
theorem kl_convex_in_p_strict_positive (p1 p2 q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp1 : ∀ a, 0 < p1 a) (hp2 : ∀ a, 0 < p2 a) (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    kl (mixDist lam p1 p2) q ≤ lam * kl p1 q + (1 - lam) * kl p2 q
proof:
by
  have h := kl_joint_convex p1 p2 q q hp1 hp2 hq hq hlam0 hlam1
  have hmix : mixDist lam q q = q := by
    funext a
    unfold mixDist
    ring
  rwa [hmix] at h

name: kl_joint_convex_sum
stmt:
theorem kl_joint_convex_sum {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℝ) (P Q : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hws : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hP : ∀ i a, 0 < P i a) (hQ : ∀ i a, 0 < Q i a) :
    kl (fun a => ∑ i, w i * P i a) (fun a => ∑ i, w i * Q i a)
      ≤ ∑ i, w i * kl (P i) (Q i)
proof:
by
  have hex : ∃ i, w i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ i, w i = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => h i)
    rw [hws] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0⟩ := hex
  have hwi0 : 0 < w i0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hw0 i0) (Ne.symm hi0)
  have hmixP : ∀ a, 0 < ∑ i, w i * P i a := by
    intro a
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hwi0 (hP i0 a))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt (hP i a)))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0))
  have hmixQ : ∀ a, 0 < ∑ i, w i * Q i a := by
    intro a
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hwi0 (hQ i0 a))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt (hQ i a)))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0))
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio _ _ hmixP hmixQ]
  have hR : ∑ i, w i * kl (P i) (Q i)
      = ∑ i, w i * ∑ a, P i a * Real.log (P i a / Q i a) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (P i) (Q i) (fun a => hP i a) (fun a => hQ i a)]
  rw [hR]
  calc ∑ a, (∑ i, w i * P i a) * Real.log ((∑ i, w i * P i a) / (∑ i, w i * Q i a))
      ≤ ∑ a, ∑ i, w i * (P i a * Real.log (P i a / Q i a)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ =>
          logsum_finset w (fun i => P i a) (fun i => Q i a) hw0 hws
            (fun i => hP i a) (fun i => hQ i a))
    _ = ∑ i, w i * ∑ a, P i a * Real.log (P i a / Q i a) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: kleeneChain_zero
stmt: @[simp] theorem kleeneChain_zero (f : α → α) : kleeneChain f 0 = ⊥
proof: rfl

name: kleeneChain_succ
stmt:
@[simp] theorem kleeneChain_succ (f : α → α) (n : ℕ) :
    kleeneChain f (n + 1) = f (kleeneChain f n)
proof: rfl

name: kleeneChain_le_succ
doc:
**相邻步递增**：单调算子的 Kleene 链 `Fⁿ⊥ ≤ F^{n+1}⊥`。
归纳：`n = 0` 用 `bot_le`，后继步用 `hf` 保持。
stmt:
theorem kleeneChain_le_succ (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, kleeneChain f n ≤ kleeneChain f (n + 1)
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact bot_le
  | succ n ih =>
      change f (kleeneChain f n) ≤ f (kleeneChain f (n + 1))
      exact hf ih

name: kleeneChain_monotone
doc: **Kleene 链关于步数单调**：`n ≤ m ⟹ Fⁿ⊥ ≤ Fᵐ⊥`。
stmt:
theorem kleeneChain_monotone (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    Monotone (kleeneChain f)
proof:
by
  intro n m hnm
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
  clear hnm
  induction d with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ d ih => exact ih.trans (kleeneChain_le_succ f hf (n + d))

name: kleeneChain_le_of_le
doc: 链的每一层都不超过其任意后继：`Fⁿ⊥ ≤ Fᵐ⊥`（`n ≤ m`）的另一种写法。
stmt:
theorem kleeneChain_le_of_le (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    kleeneChain f n ≤ kleeneChain f m
proof:
kleeneChain_monotone f hf h

                                     

variable [Fintype α]

name: kleeneChain_stabilizes
doc:
**稳定性的存在性（鸽笼原理）**：有限偏序上单调算子的 Kleene 链必在
某步出现重复 `Fⁿ⊥ = F^{n+1}⊥`。
反证：若前 `card α` 步都严格增，则 `Fin (card α + 1) → α` 的单射给出
`card α + 1 ≤ card α` 的矛盾。
stmt:
theorem kleeneChain_stabilizes (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, kleeneChain f N = kleeneChain f (N + 1)
proof:
by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, kleeneChain f n ≤ kleeneChain f (n + 1) := kleeneChain_le_succ f hf
  have hlt : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ Fintype.card α → kleeneChain f n < kleeneChain f (n + 1) :=
    fun n hn => lt_of_le_of_ne (hle n) (h n)
  have hmono : Monotone (kleeneChain f) := kleeneChain_monotone f hf
                         
  have hltj : ∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ Fintype.card α → i < j →
      kleeneChain f i < kleeneChain f j := by
    intro i j hi hij
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hij
    have h1 : kleeneChain f i < kleeneChain f (i + 1) := hlt i hi
    have h2 : kleeneChain f (i + 1) ≤ kleeneChain f (i + d + 1) := hmono (by omega)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
                                
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) => kleeneChain f (i : ℕ)) := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Fin.ext
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hltij | hgtij
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hltj (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) (by have := i.isLt; omega) hltij)) hij
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hltj (j : ℕ) (i : ℕ) (by have := j.isLt; omega) hgtij)) hij.symm
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) => kleeneChain f (i : ℕ)) hinj
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  omega

name: kleeneStabIndex_spec
doc: **`Nat.find` 的刻画（spec）**：`kleeneStabIndex f` 处链确实稳定。
stmt:
theorem kleeneStabIndex_spec (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf) = kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + 1)
proof: Nat.find_spec (kleeneChain_stabilizes f hf)

name: kleeneStabIndex_minimal
doc: **`Nat.find` 的极小性**：任何使链稳定的步数都不小于 `kleeneStabIndex f`。
proof: Nat.find_min' (kleeneChain_stabilizes f hf) hn

name: kleeneStabIndex_le_card
doc:
**最小稳定步的上界 `≤ card α`**：这是「有限步稳定」的定量形式
（步数不超过有限格的基数）。
stmt:
theorem kleeneStabIndex_le_card (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    kleeneStabIndex f hf ≤ Fintype.card α

name: kleeneLimit_fixed
doc:
**稳定值是不动点**：`f (kleeneLimit f) = kleeneLimit f`。
由 `kleeneStabIndex_spec`（稳定）与 `kleeneChain_succ`（一步展开）直接得到。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_fixed (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    f (kleeneLimit f hf) = kleeneLimit f hf
proof:
by
  have hspec := kleeneStabIndex_spec f hf
  have h1 : kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + 1) = f (kleeneLimit f hf) := rfl
  rw [← h1]
  exact hspec.symm

name: kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed
doc:
**最小性**：`kleeneLimit f` 不超过任意不动点 `y`（`f y = y`）。
归纳：`Fⁿ⊥ ≤ y` 对一切 `n`（`n = 0` 用 `bot_le`，后继用 `hf`），再取 `n = 稳定步`。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) {y : α} (hy : f y = y) :
    kleeneLimit f hf ≤ y
proof:
by
  have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, kleeneChain f n ≤ y := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact bot_le
    | succ n ih =>
        change f (kleeneChain f n) ≤ y
        rw [← hy]
        exact hf ih
  exact hbound (kleeneStabIndex f hf)

name: kleeneChain_eq_limit_of_le
doc:
**稳定后恒定**：若 `kleeneStabIndex f ≤ n`，则 `Fⁿ⊥ = kleeneLimit f`。
即链在最小稳定步之后不再变化。
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  clear hn
  have hfix := kleeneLimit_fixed f hf
  induction d with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ d ih =>
      have hstep : kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + (d + 1))
          = f (kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + d)) := rfl
      rw [hstep, ih, hfix]

name: kleene_fixed_point_finite
doc:
**Kleene 不动点定理（有限格版本，打包）**：有限偏序 + 有底 + 单调算子 ⟹
存在唯一的最小稳定步 `N ≤ card α`，链在 `N` 处稳定、稳定值是不动点且最小。
这是 Knaster–Tarski / Kleene 的**有限步稳定**形态，四条件一并给出。
stmt:
theorem kleene_fixed_point_finite (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    kleeneStabIndex f hf ≤ Fintype.card α ∧
      kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf) = kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + 1) ∧
      f (kleeneLimit f hf) = kleeneLimit f hf ∧
      (∀ y : α, f y = y → kleeneLimit f hf ≤ y)
proof:
⟨kleeneStabIndex_le_card f hf, kleeneStabIndex_spec f hf,
   kleeneLimit_fixed f hf, fun _ hy => kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed f hf hy⟩

name: kleeneLimit_unique_minimal
doc:
**最小不动点的唯一性**：任意使 `f y = y` 且被 `kleeneLimit f` 支配的 `y`
必与之相等（最小性是「≤」，配合 `kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed` 得双向）。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_unique_minimal (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) {y : α} (hy : f y = y)
    (hle : y ≤ kleeneLimit f hf) :
    y = kleeneLimit f hf
proof:
le_antisymm hle (kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed f hf hy)

                                   

section Powerset

variable {β : Type*} [Fintype β]

name: kleeneLimit_eq_iUnion
doc:
**幂集格上最小不动点 = Kleene 链的并 `⋃ₙ Fⁿ ∅`**（「最小结 = ⋃ₙ Fⁿ ∅」）：
单调 `F` 的最小不动点恰等于链的并。因为链在 `≤ card (Set β)` 步稳定，
并就是稳定项本身。
（本文件只声称**并 = 最小不动点**；`Set β` 的有限性由 `Fintype β` 保证，
故 `Fintype (Set β)` 由 `Set.fintype` 提供。）
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_eq_iUnion (F : Set β → Set β) (hF : Monotone F) :
    (kleeneLimit F hF : Set β) = ⋃ n : ℕ, kleeneChain F n
proof:
by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨kleeneStabIndex F hF, hx⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
                             
    by_cases hle : n ≤ kleeneStabIndex F hF
    · exact kleeneChain_monotone F hF hle hn
    · have hge : kleeneStabIndex F hF ≤ n := by omega
      rw [kleeneChain_eq_limit_of_le F hF hge] at hn
      exact hn

name: kleeneLimit_mem_iff
doc:
**并的成员刻画**：`x` 属于最小不动点 ⟺ `x` 属于某个 `Fⁿ ∅`。
先用 `kleeneLimit_eq_iUnion` 把最小不动点换写成链的并，再用 `Set.mem_iUnion`。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_mem_iff (F : Set β → Set β) (hF : Monotone F) (x : β) :
    x ∈ (kleeneLimit F hF : Set β) ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ kleeneChain F n
proof:
by
  rw [kleeneLimit_eq_iUnion F hF]
  exact Set.mem_iUnion

name: kleeneLimit_subset_of_fixed
doc:
**「最小结」的 `⊆`-刻画**：最小不动点包含于任意不动点（即任意「结」）。
这是幂集格上的最小性重述（「最小结」= 包含于所有结）。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_subset_of_fixed (F : Set β → Set β) (hF : Monotone F)
    {Y : Set β} (hY : F Y = Y) :
    (kleeneLimit F hF : Set β) ⊆ Y
proof: fun _ hx => kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed F hF hY hx

name: kleeneLimit_card_le_of_fixed
doc:
**不动点的基数上界**：任何不动点都至少与最小不动点一样大
（基数形式：`|最小结| ≤ |任意结|`，由 `⊆` 推出）。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_card_le_of_fixed (F : Set β → Set β) (hF : Monotone F)
    {Y : Set β} (hY : F Y = Y) :
    (kleeneLimit F hF).ncard ≤ Y.ncard
proof:
Set.ncard_le_ncard (kleeneLimit_subset_of_fixed F hF hY)

end Powerset

name: mul_log_sub_add_nonneg
doc:
**标量核心（非严格）**：`0 < u` ⟹ `0 ≤ u·log u − u + 1`。

证明：`Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hu : 1 − u⁻¹ ≤ log u` 乘 `u > 0` 得
`u − 1 ≤ u·log u`，整理即得。这是 `u·log u` 在 `u = 1` 处切线的全局下界。
stmt:
lemma mul_log_sub_add_nonneg {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    0 ≤ u * Real.log u - u + 1
proof:
by
  have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hu
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (le_of_lt hu)
  have heq : u * (1 - u⁻¹) = u - 1 := by field_simp
  rw [heq] at hmul
  linarith

name: one_sub_inv_lt_log_of_pos_logsum
doc:
**严格版 Gibbs 下界**：`0 < u`、`u ≠ 1` ⟹ `1 − u⁻¹ < Real.log u`。

证明：在 `u⁻¹` 处用 `Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos` 得 `log(u⁻¹) < u⁻¹ − 1`，
再用 `Real.log_inv` 化为 `−log u < u⁻¹ − 1`。

命名带 `_logsum` 后缀以避开 `RealEqualityCharacterization.one_sub_inv_lt_log_of_pos`
（同义、只读），遵守「不重定义已有声明」的约束。
stmt:
lemma one_sub_inv_lt_log_of_pos_logsum {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u ≠ 1) :
    1 - u⁻¹ < Real.log u
proof:
by
  have hinv1 : u⁻¹ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hu1
    have h' := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹) h
    simpa using h'
  have h := Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hu) hinv1
  rw [Real.log_inv] at h
  linarith

name: mul_log_sub_add_pos
doc:
**标量核心（严格）**：`0 < u`、`u ≠ 1` ⟹ `0 < u·log u − u + 1`。

证明：`one_sub_inv_lt_log_of_pos_logsum` 乘 `u > 0` 得 `u − 1 < u·log u`。
stmt:
lemma mul_log_sub_add_pos {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hu1 : u ≠ 1) :
    0 < u * Real.log u - u + 1
proof:
by
  have h := one_sub_inv_lt_log_of_pos_logsum hu hu1
  have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hu
  have heq : u * (1 - u⁻¹) = u - 1 := by field_simp
  rw [heq] at hmul
  linarith

name: mul_log_sub_add_eq_zero_iff
doc:
**标量等号刻画（`u·log u` 形式）**：`0 < u` ⟹ `u·log u − u + 1 = 0 ⟺ u = 1`。

正向用 `mul_log_sub_add_pos` 反证；反向显然。这是主定理中「逐项取等 ⟹ `A i = 1`」
一步的引擎。
stmt:
lemma mul_log_sub_add_eq_zero_iff {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    u * Real.log u - u + 1 = 0 ↔ u = 1
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hu1
    have hpos := mul_log_sub_add_pos hu hu1
    linarith
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: log_eq_one_sub_inv_iff_logsum
doc:
**标量等号刻画（`log` 的 Gibbs 形式）**：`0 < u` ⟹ `log u = 1 − u⁻¹ ⟺ u = 1`。

命名带 `_logsum` 后缀以避开只读的 `RealEqualityCharacterization.log_eq_one_sub_inv_iff`
（同义），遵守「不重定义已有声明」的约束。
stmt:
lemma log_eq_one_sub_inv_iff_logsum {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    Real.log u = 1 - u⁻¹ ↔ u = 1
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hu1
    have hlt := one_sub_inv_lt_log_of_pos_logsum hu hu1
    linarith
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: logsum_eq_iff_ratio_const
doc:
**log-sum 不等式的等号判据（主定理）**。

`z z'` 逐点严格正时：

`(Σ z)·log((Σ z)/(Σ z')) = Σ z·log(z/z')  ⟺  ∀ i, z i·(Σ z') = z' i·(Σ z)`。

右端即「比值 `z i / z' i` 对所有 `i` 恒等于 `(Σ z)/(Σ z')`」（等价形式见
`logsum_eq_iff_exists_ratio_const`）。

正向（等号 ⟹ 比值常值）是 `RealDPIComplete.lean` 31–48 行标注为缺口、本文件
**补上**的那一半：把 `RealDataProcessing.logsum_le` 证明内部的分解恒等式
`(Σ z·log(z/z')) − m·log(m/r) = Σ z·log(A i)`（`A i = z i·r/(z' i·m)`）
与 `Σ z i·(1 − A i⁻¹) = 0` 提取出来，配合每项 `z i·(1 − A i⁻¹) ≤ z i·log(A i)`，
由「非负项之和为 0 ⟹ 逐项为 0」得 `log(A i) = 1 − A i⁻¹`，
再用标量等号刻画 `mul_log_sub_add_eq_zero_iff` 得 `A i = 1`。

反向（比值常值 ⟹ 等号）由 `Finset.sum_mul` 收尾。
stmt:
theorem logsum_eq_iff_ratio_const {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (z z' : ι → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 < z i) (hz' : ∀ i, 0 < z' i) :
    ((∑ i, z i) * Real.log ((∑ i, z i) / (∑ i, z' i)) = ∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i))
      ↔ ∀ i, z i * (∑ j, z' j) = z' i * (∑ j, z j)
proof:
by
  constructor
  ·                
    intro heq
    have hmpos : 0 < ∑ i, z i :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz i) Finset.univ_nonempty
    have hrpos : 0 < ∑ i, z' i :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz' i) Finset.univ_nonempty
    set m : ℝ := ∑ i, z i with hm
    set r : ℝ := ∑ i, z' i with hr
    set A : ι → ℝ := fun i => z i * r / (z' i * m) with hA
    have hApos : ∀ i, 0 < A i :=
      fun i => div_pos (mul_pos (hz i) hrpos) (mul_pos (hz' i) hmpos)
                                                            
                                                                   
                                             
    have heq' : m * Real.log (m / r) = ∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i) := heq
                                                                                
    have hlogA : ∀ i, Real.log (A i)
        = (Real.log (z i) - Real.log (z' i)) + (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
      intro i
      have h1 : A i = (z i / z' i) * (r / m) := by
        rw [hA]
        exact (div_mul_div_comm (z i) (z' i) r m).symm
      rw [h1, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos (hz i) (hz' i)))
            (ne_of_gt (div_pos hrpos hmpos)),
        Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hz i)) (ne_of_gt (hz' i)),
        Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hrpos) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
    have hsplit : ∑ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
        = (∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) + m * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
      have hterm : ∀ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
          = z i * Real.log (z i / z' i) + z i *

name: logsum_eq_iff_eq_of_sum_eq
doc:
**归一化等号判据**：当 `Σ z = Σ z'` 时，log-sum 的等号 ⟺ `z = z'`。

由主定理 `logsum_eq_iff_ratio_const` 与 `hs` 直接化去求和：交叉相乘关系
`z i·(Σ z') = z' i·(Σ z)` 在 `Σ z = Σ z' =: S > 0` 下化为 `z i·S = z' i·S`，
再由 `S > 0` 消去。这是 DPI 等号刻画「等号 ⟹ p = q」所用的最终形式
（输入分布 `p q` 常常分别归一）。
stmt:
theorem logsum_eq_iff_eq_of_sum_eq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (z z' : ι → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 < z i) (hz' : ∀ i, 0 < z' i) (hs : ∑ i, z i = ∑ i, z' i) :
    ((∑ i, z i) * Real.log ((∑ i, z i) / (∑ i, z' i)) = ∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i))
      ↔ ∀ i, z i = z' i
proof:
by
  rw [logsum_eq_iff_ratio_const z z' hz hz']
  have hmpos : 0 < ∑ j, z j := Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => hz j) Finset.univ_nonempty
  constructor
  · intro h i
    have hi := h i
    rw [← hs] at hi
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hmpos) hi
  · intro h i
    rw [h i, ← hs]

name: logsum_eq_iff_exists_ratio_const
doc:
**比值常值的等价叙述**：log-sum 的等号 ⟺ 存在 `c > 0` 使
`∀ i, z i / z' i = c`（且此时必有 `c = (Σ z)/(Σ z')`）。

由主定理除以 `Σ z' > 0` 得到；反向用 `z i = c·z' i` 逐项求和得
`Σ z = c·Σ z'`，再验证交叉相乘关系。
stmt:
theorem logsum_eq_iff_exists_ratio_const {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (z z' : ι → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 < z i) (hz' : ∀ i, 0 < z' i) :
    ((∑ i, z i) * Real.log ((∑ i, z i) / (∑ i, z' i)) = ∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i))
      ↔ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ i, z i / z' i = c
proof:
by
  have hmpos : 0 < ∑ i, z i := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hrpos : 0 < ∑ i, z' i := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz' i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  rw [logsum_eq_iff_ratio_const z z' hz hz']
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(∑ i, z i) / (∑ i, z' i), div_pos hmpos hrpos, fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt (hz' i)) (ne_of_gt hrpos)]
    have hi := h i
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨c, _hc, hci⟩ i
    have h1 : ∀ j, z j = c * z' j :=
      fun j => (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt (hz' j))).mp (hci j)
    have hsum : ∑ j, z j = c * ∑ j, z' j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => h1 j), Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [h1 i, hsum]
    ring

end Lattice

name: unifDist_pos
doc: 均匀分布严格正（k ≠ 0）。
stmt: lemma unifDist_pos (hk : k ≠ 0) (a : Fin k) : 0 < unifDist k a
proof:
by
  unfold unifDist
  exact inv_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk)

name: unifDist_sum
doc: 均匀分布是概率向量（k ≠ 0）。
stmt: lemma unifDist_sum (hk : k ≠ 0) : ∑ a : Fin k, unifDist k a = 1
proof:
by
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
  have h : ∑ a : Fin k, unifDist k a = ∑ _a : Fin k, (k : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => rfl)
  rw [h, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hkpos)

name: crossEntropy_unif
stmt:
lemma crossEntropy_unif (p : Fin k → ℝ) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) :
    crossEntropy p (unifDist k) = Real.log k
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ a : Fin k, p a * Real.log (unifDist k a) = p a * (-Real.log k) := by
    intro a
    unfold unifDist
    rw [Real.log_inv]
  unfold crossEntropy
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hterm a)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hpsum]
  ring

name: entropy_le_log_card
stmt:
theorem entropy_le_log_card (p : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a)
    (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) :
    entropy p ≤ Real.log k
proof:
by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hpsum
  have hkl := kl_nonneg p (unifDist k) hp0 hpsum (unifDist_pos hk) (unifDist_sum hk)
  have hce := crossEntropy_unif p hpsum
  have hbridge : kl p (unifDist k) = Real.log k - entropy p := by
    unfold kl
    rw [hce]
  linarith

name: entropy_unif
stmt: theorem entropy_unif (hk : k ≠ 0) : entropy (unifDist k) = Real.log k
proof:
by
  have hce := crossEntropy_unif (unifDist k) (unifDist_sum hk)
  unfold entropy
  exact hce

theorem entropy_maximized_by_uniform (p : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a)

name: entropy_eq_log_card_iff_uniform
stmt:
theorem entropy_eq_log_card_iff_uniform (p : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a)
    (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) :
    entropy p = Real.log k ↔ p = unifDist k

by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hpsum
  have hce := crossEntropy_unif p hpsum
  have hbridge : kl p (unifDist k) = Real.log k - entropy p := by

name: crossEntropy_gibbs
doc:
核心恒等式：CE(r, q) = −θ·(Σ_a r_a·g_a) + log Z(θ)（r 为概率向量）。
右侧只通过矩 Σ r_a·g_a 依赖 r，这是「指数族是矩约束下的最大熵分布」的代数核心。
stmt:
lemma crossEntropy_gibbs [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g r : Fin k → ℝ) (theta : ℝ)
    (hsum : ∑ a, r a = 1) :
    crossEntropy r (gibbsDist g theta)
      = -theta * (∑ a, r a * g a) + Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta)
proof:
by
  have hlog : ∀ a, Real.log (gibbsDist g theta a)
      = theta * g a - Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta) := by
    intro a
    unfold gibbsDist
    rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos _)) (ne_of_gt (gibbsPartition_pos g theta)),
      Real.log_exp]
  have hs : ∑ a, r a * (theta * g a - Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta))
      = theta * (∑ a, r a * g a)
        - (∑ a, r a) * Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta) := by
    have hterm : ∀ a : Fin k,
        r a * (theta * g a - Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta))
          = theta * (r a * g a) - r a * Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta) := by
      intro a
      ring
    calc ∑ a, r a * (theta * g a - Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta))
        = ∑ a, (theta * (r a * g a) - r a * Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta)) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hterm a)
      _ = (∑ a, theta * (r a * g a)) - ∑ a, r a * Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta) :=
          Finset.sum_sub_distrib
      _ = theta * (∑ a, r a * g a)
            - (∑ a, r a) * Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  unfold crossEntropy
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => by rw [hlog a]), hs, hsum]
  ring

name: maxEntropy_with_moment_constraint
doc:
矩约束下的最大熵（指数族变分刻画）：
若 p（严格正概率向量）与指数族 q = Gibbs(g, θ) 共享同一矩 Σ p_a·g_a，
则 H(p) ≤ H(q)。证明：Gibbs 不等式 H(p) ≤ CE(p,q)，
而 `crossEntropy_gibbs` 给出 CE(p,q) = −θ·矩 + log Z = H(q)。
stmt:
theorem maxEntropy_with_moment_constraint (g p : Fin k → ℝ) (theta : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hmoment : ∑ a, p a * g a = ∑ a, gibbsDist g theta a * g a) :
    entropy p ≤ entropy (gibbsDist g theta)
proof:
by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hpsum
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
  have hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < gibbsDist g theta a := gibbsDist_pos g theta
  have hqs : ∑ a, gibbsDist g theta a = 1 := gibbsDist_sum g theta
  have hge := ce_ge_entropy p (gibbsDist g theta) hp0 hpsum hq0 hqs
  have hce := crossEntropy_gibbs g p theta hpsum
  have hqe : entropy (gibbsDist g theta)
      = -theta * (∑ a, p a * g a) + Real.log (gibbsPartition g theta) := by
    unfold entropy
    rw [crossEntropy_gibbs g (gibbsDist g theta) theta hqs, ← hmoment]
  rw [hce] at hge
  rw [← hqe] at hge
  exact hge

end Lattice

name: variance_nonneg
stmt:
theorem variance_nonneg [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ variance g θ
proof:
by
  have hq : ∀ a, 0 ≤ gibbsDist g θ a := fun a => le_of_lt (gibbsDist_pos g θ a)
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (s := Finset.univ)
    (f := fun a => Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a))
    (g := fun a => Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * g a)
  have hx : (∑ a, Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a)
        * (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * g a)) = momentMap g θ := by
    unfold momentMap
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [show Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * g a)
        = (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a)) * g a by ring,
      Real.mul_self_sqrt (hq a)]
  have hf : (∑ a, (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a)) ^ 2) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Real.sq_sqrt (hq a)), gibbsDist_sum g θ]
  have hg' : (∑ a, (Real.sqrt (gibbsDist g θ a) * g a) ^ 2)
      = ∑ a, gibbsDist g θ a * (g a) ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hq a)]
  rw [hx, hf, hg', one_mul] at hcs
  unfold variance
  linarith

name: momentMap_eq_deriv_logZ
stmt:
theorem momentMap_eq_deriv_logZ [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => Real.log (gibbsPartition g t)) θ = momentMap g θ
proof:
by
  have hZ : HasDerivAt (fun t => gibbsPartition g t)
      (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a) θ := by
    unfold gibbsPartition
    apply HasDerivAt.sum
    intro a _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * g a) (1 * g a) θ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id θ).mul_const (g a)
    have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (θ * g a)).comp θ h1
    simpa using h2
  have hZpos : gibbsPartition g θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (gibbsPartition_pos g θ)
  have hlog := hZ.log hZpos
  rw [hlog.deriv]
  unfold momentMap gibbsDist
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: variance_eq_quotient
doc:
方差的有理化形式（N = Σ_a g_a·e^{θg_a}、N' = Σ_a g_a²·e^{θg_a}、Z' = Σ_a e^{θg_a}·g_a）：
V(θ) = (N'·Z(θ) − N·Z') / Z(θ)²。
stmt:
lemma variance_eq_quotient [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    variance g θ
      = ((∑ a, g a * (g a * Real.exp (θ * g a))) * gibbsPartition g θ
          - (∑ a, g a * Real.exp (θ * g a)) * (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a))
        / gibbsPartition g θ ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hZ : gibbsPartition g θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (gibbsPartition_pos g θ)
  have h1 : ∑ a, gibbsDist g θ a * (g a) ^ 2
      = (∑ a, g a * (g a * Real.exp (θ * g a))) / gibbsPartition g θ := by
    unfold gibbsDist
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  have h2 : ∑ a, gibbsDist g θ a * g a
      = (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a) / gibbsPartition g θ := by
    unfold gibbsDist
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  have h3 : (∑ a, g a * Real.exp (θ * g a)) = (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  unfold variance momentMap
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  field_simp [hZ]
  ring

name: momentMap_deriv
stmt:
theorem momentMap_deriv [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    deriv (momentMap g) θ = variance g θ
proof:
by
  have hZ : HasDerivAt (fun t => gibbsPartition g t)
      (∑ a, Real.exp (θ * g a) * g a) θ := by
    unfold gibbsPartition
    apply HasDerivAt.sum
    intro a _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * g a) (1 * g a) θ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id θ).mul_const (g a)
    have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (θ * g a)).comp θ h1
    simpa using h2
  have hN : HasDerivAt (fun t => ∑ a, g a * Real.exp (t * g a))
      (∑ a, g a * (g a * Real.exp (θ * g a))) θ := by
    apply HasDerivAt.sum
    intro a _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * g a) (1 * g a) θ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id θ).mul_const (g a)
    have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (θ * g a)).comp θ h1
    have h3 := h2.const_mul (g a)
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h3
  have hZpos : gibbsPartition g θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (gibbsPartition_pos g θ)
  have hdiv := hN.div hZ hZpos
  have hfun : momentMap g
      = fun t => (∑ a, g a * Real.exp (t * g a)) / gibbsPartition g t := by
    funext t
    unfold momentMap gibbsDist
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    ring
  rw [hfun, hdiv.deriv, variance_eq_quotient]

name: momentMap_strictMono
doc:
矩映射严格单调递增：∂_θ momentMap = V > 0 ⟹ StrictMono（`strictMono_of_deriv_pos`）。
（V > 0 是显式假设，见「诚实边界」。）
stmt:
theorem momentMap_strictMono [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hvar : ∀ θ, 0 < variance g θ) : StrictMono (momentMap g)
proof:
strictMono_of_deriv_pos (fun θ => by
    rw [momentMap_deriv g θ]
    exact hvar θ)

name: momentMap_injective
stmt:
theorem momentMap_injective (g : Fin k → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono (momentMap g)) :
    Function.Injective (momentMap g)
proof: hmono.injective

name: unique_theta_for_moment
doc:
给定目标矩 m 在矩映射值域内、且矩映射严格单调 ⟹ 存在唯一 θ 使 momentMap(g,θ) = m。
   「存在」由 hrange 直接给出，「唯一」由严格单调的单射性。
stmt:
theorem unique_theta_for_moment (g : Fin k → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hmono : StrictMono (momentMap g)) (hrange : ∃ θ, momentMap g θ = m) :
    ∃! θ, momentMap g θ = m
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨θ0, hθ0⟩ := hrange
  refine ⟨θ0, hθ0, ?_⟩
  intro θ hθ
  exact hmono.injective (by rw [hθ, hθ0])

name: unique_theta_for_moment_of_mono
stmt:
theorem unique_theta_for_moment_of_mono [Nonempty (Fin k)] (g : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hvar : ∀ θ, 0 < variance g θ) (m : ℝ)
    (hrange : ∃ θ, momentMap g θ = m) :
    ∃! θ, momentMap g θ = m
proof:
unique_theta_for_moment g m (momentMap_strictMono g hvar) hrange

end Lattice

name: gibbs_term
stmt:
lemma gibbs_term {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    x - y ≤ x * (Real.log x - Real.log y)
proof: gibbs_ineq hx hy

name: marginalRow_nonneg
stmt:
lemma marginalRow_nonneg (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ p a b) (a : Fin m) :
    0 ≤ marginalRow p a
proof: Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hp0 a b)

name: marginalCol_nonneg
stmt:
lemma marginalCol_nonneg (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ p a b) (b : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ marginalCol p b
proof: Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => hp0 a b)

name: prodDist_sum
stmt:
lemma prodDist_sum (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, prodDist p a b) = (∑ a, marginalRow p a) * (∑ b, marginalCol p b)
proof:
by
  unfold prodDist
  calc
    (∑ a, ∑ b, marginalRow p a * marginalCol p b)
        = ∑ a, marginalRow p a * (∑ b, marginalCol p b) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = (∑ a, marginalRow p a) * (∑ b, marginalCol p b) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: mi_as_sum_log_ratio
stmt:
theorem mi_as_sum_log_ratio (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 < p a b)
    (hr : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow p a) (hc : ∀ b, 0 < marginalCol p b) :
    mutualInformation p = ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (p a b / prodDist p a b)
proof:
by
  unfold mutualInformation
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hp0 a b)) (ne_of_gt (prodDist_pos p a b (hr a) (hc b)))]

name: mutual_information_nonneg
stmt:
theorem mutual_information_nonneg (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ p a b)
    (hsum : ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b = 1)
    (hr : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow p a) (hc : ∀ b, 0 < marginalCol p b) :
    0 ≤ mutualInformation p
proof:
by
  have hcol : ∑ b, marginalCol p b = 1 := by
    unfold marginalCol
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact hsum
  have hq : ∑ a, ∑ b, prodDist p a b = 1 := by
    rw [prodDist_sum]
    have hrow : ∑ a, marginalRow p a = 1 := hsum
    rw [hrow, hcol, one_mul]
  have hterm : ∀ a b,
      p a b - prodDist p a b ≤ p a b * (Real.log (p a b) - Real.log (prodDist p a b)) := by
    intro a b
    exact gibbs_term (hp0 a b) (prodDist_pos p a b (hr a) (hc b))
  have hsumdiff : ∑ a, ∑ b, (p a b - prodDist p a b) = 0 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hsum, hq]
    ring
  calc
    0 = ∑ a, ∑ b, (p a b - prodDist p a b) := hsumdiff.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * (Real.log (p a b) - Real.log (prodDist p a b)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => hterm a b))
    _ = mutualInformation p := rfl

name: mutual_information_comm
stmt:
theorem mutual_information_comm (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    mutualInformation p = mutualInformation (fun (b : Fin n) (a : Fin m) => p a b)
proof:
by
  simp only [mutualInformation, prodDist, marginalRow, marginalCol]
  conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  congr 1
  rw [mul_comm]

name: mi_eq_zero_of_independent
stmt:
theorem mi_eq_zero_of_independent (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ a b, p a b = prodDist p a b) : mutualInformation p = 0
proof:
by
  unfold mutualInformation
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro b _
  rw [h a b, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: marginalRow_sum_eq_one
stmt:
lemma marginalRow_sum_eq_one (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b = 1) :
    ∑ a, marginalRow p a = 1
proof: hsum

name: marginalCol_sum_eq_one
stmt:
lemma marginalCol_sum_eq_one (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hsum : ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b = 1) :
    ∑ b, marginalCol p b = 1
proof:
by
  unfold marginalCol
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact hsum

end Lattice

name: continuous_apply₂
doc: 坐标投影 `π ↦ π a b` 在 `α → β → ℝ` 上是连续的。
stmt:
theorem continuous_apply₂ (a : α) (b : β) :
    Continuous fun π : α → β → ℝ => π a b
proof:
by
  have h1 : Continuous fun π : α → β → ℝ => π a := continuous_apply a
  have h2 : Continuous fun f : β → ℝ => f b := continuous_apply b
  exact h2.comp h1

name: isClosed_setOf_isTransportPlan
doc:
可行集的**闭性**：`IsTransportPlan p q` 是有限个闭条件（非负性 + 两组线性等式）
的交，因此 `{π | IsTransportPlan p q π}` 在 `α → β → ℝ` 中是闭集。
stmt:
theorem isClosed_setOf_isTransportPlan (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) :
    IsClosed {π : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π}
proof:
by
  have h1 : IsClosed {π : α → β → ℝ | ∀ a b, 0 ≤ π a b} := by
    rw [Set.setOf_forall]
    refine isClosed_iInter fun a => ?_
    rw [Set.setOf_forall]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun b =>
      isClosed_Ici.preimage (continuous_apply₂ a b)
  have h2 : IsClosed {π : α → β → ℝ | ∀ a, ∑ b, π a b = p a} := by
    rw [Set.setOf_forall]
    refine isClosed_iInter fun a => ?_
    exact isClosed_eq
      (continuous_finset_sum _ fun b _ => continuous_apply₂ a b)
      continuous_const
  have h3 : IsClosed {π : α → β → ℝ | ∀ b, ∑ a, π a b = q b} := by
    rw [Set.setOf_forall]
    refine isClosed_iInter fun b => ?_
    exact isClosed_eq
      (continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuous_apply₂ a b)
      continuous_const
  have heq : {π : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π} =
      {π : α → β → ℝ | ∀ a b, 0 ≤ π a b} ∩
        {π : α → β → ℝ | ∀ a, ∑ b, π a b = p a} ∩
          {π : α → β → ℝ | ∀ b, ∑ a, π a b = q b} := by
    ext π
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩, h.2.2⟩
    · intro h
      exact ⟨h.1.1, h.1.2, h.2⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact (h1.inter h2).inter h3

name: isBounded_setOf_isTransportPlan
doc:
可行集的**有界性**：由行边缘 `∑ b, π a b = p a` 与非负性，
`π a b ≤ ∑ b, π a b = p a ≤ |p a| ≤ ∑ a, |p a|`，
故可行集包含在以原点为心、`∑ a, |p a|` 为半径的闭球内。
stmt:
theorem isBounded_setOf_isTransportPlan (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) :
    Bornology.IsBounded {π : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π}
proof:
by
  rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : α → β → ℝ)]
  refine ⟨∑ a, |p a|, ?_⟩
  intro π hπ
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
  have hR : 0 ≤ ∑ a, |p a| := Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => abs_nonneg (p a)
  rw [dist_pi_le_iff hR]
  intro a
  rw [dist_pi_le_iff hR]
  intro b
  rw [show (0 : α → β → ℝ) a b = 0 from rfl, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have habs : |π a b| = π a b := abs_of_nonneg (hπ.1 a b)
  rw [habs]
  calc π a b ≤ ∑ b', π a b' :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun b' _ => hπ.1 a b') (Finset.mem_univ b)
    _ = p a := hπ.2.1 a
    _ ≤ |p a| := le_abs_self (p a)
    _ ≤ ∑ a', |p a'| := Finset.single_le_sum (fun a' _ => abs_nonneg (p a')) (Finset.mem_univ a)

name: isCompact_setOf_isTransportPlan
doc: 可行集的**紧性**：由闭性 + 有界性（有限维空间是 proper 空间，Heine–Borel）。
stmt:
theorem isCompact_setOf_isTransportPlan (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) :
    IsCompact {π : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π}
proof:
Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr
    ⟨isClosed_setOf_isTransportPlan p q, isBounded_setOf_isTransportPlan p q⟩

name: transportPlan_nonempty
doc: **可行集非空**（存在形式）：概率向量 `p, q` 的传输计划集非空。
stmt:
theorem transportPlan_nonempty (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1) :
    ∃ π : α → β → ℝ, IsTransportPlan p q π
proof: ⟨fun a b => p a * q b, productPlan_isPlan p q hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1⟩

name: transportPlan_convex
doc: **可行集是凸集**：两个传输计划的凸组合仍是传输计划。
stmt:
theorem transportPlan_convex (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ)
    (π₁ π₂ : α → β → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (h₁ : IsTransportPlan p q π₁) (h₂ : IsTransportPlan p q π₂)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    IsTransportPlan p q (fun a b => t * π₁ a b + (1 - t) * π₂ a b)
proof:
by
  have ht0' : 0 ≤ 1 - t := sub_nonneg.mpr ht1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht0 (h₁.1 a b)) (mul_nonneg ht0' (h₂.1 a b))
  · intro a
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have e1 : ∑ b, t * π₁ a b = t * p a := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, h₁.2.1]
    have e2 : ∑ b, (1 - t) * π₂ a b = (1 - t) * p a := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, h₂.2.1]
    rw [e1, e2]
    ring
  · intro b
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have e1 : ∑ a, t * π₁ a b = t * q b := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, h₁.2.2]
    have e2 : ∑ a, (1 - t) * π₂ a b = (1 - t) * q b := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, h₂.2.2]
    rw [e1, e2]
    ring

name: dual_weak_optimal
doc:
**对偶弱定理（最优计划形式）**：若 `π*` 是最优计划，
则对任意下界势 `(f, g)`，
`∑ a, f a * p a + ∑ b, g b * q b ≤ transportCost c π*`。
即对偶问题的任意可行值不超过原问题的最优值（`max_{f,g} ≤ min_π` 的一半）。
stmt:
theorem dual_weak_optimal (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) (c : α → β → ℝ)
    (πstar : α → β → ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) (g : β → ℝ)
    (hπ : IsTransportPlan p q πstar)
    (_hopt : ∀ π : α → β → ℝ, IsTransportPlan p q π →
      transportCost c πstar ≤ transportCost c π)
    (hfg : ∀ a b, f a + g b ≤ c a b) :
    (∑ a, f a * p a) + (∑ b, g b * q b) ≤ transportCost c πstar
proof: dual_weak p q c πstar f g hπ hfg

name: transportCost_nonneg_of_nonneg
doc: 若代价 `c` 逐点非负，则 `transportCost c` 在任意可行计划上非负。
proof:
by
  unfold transportCost
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => mul_nonneg (hπ.1 a b) (hc a b)

name: bddBelow_transportCost_image
doc: 非负代价下，代价像有下界 `0`。
stmt:
theorem bddBelow_transportCost_image (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) (c : α → β → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ c a b) :
    BddBelow (transportCost c '' {π : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π})
proof:
⟨0, fun y hy => by
    rcases hy with ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩
    exact transportCost_nonneg_of_nonneg hπ hc⟩

name: otValue_le_cost
doc:
**非负代价下任意可行计划的代价 ≥ `otValue`**（下确界的下界性质）。

**诚实标注**：需要代价逐点非负（`hc`）才能给出与 `π` 无关的下界；
没有 `hc` 时下确界可能是 `−∞` 形式（在 `ℝ` 上表现为无下界），
本条不声称那种情形。
proof:
by
  have hbdd := bddBelow_transportCost_image p q c hc
  show sInf (transportCost c '' {σ : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q σ}) ≤ transportCost c π
  exact csInf_le hbdd ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩

name: exists_plan_attaining_otValue
doc:
**最优值被取到**：概率向量 `p, q` 与非负代价 `c` 下，
存在可行计划 `π*`，其代价恰为 `otValue p q c`。
（用 `isCompact_setOf_isTransportPlan` 上的极值定理，而不是 `csInf_mem`
——后者在本版 mathlib 要求 `WellFoundedLT ℝ`，对实数不成立。）

**诚实边界**：这里只断言 `π*` 存在且达到 `otValue`；**不**给出 `π*` 的显式构造
（例如西北角法 / 单调耦合）。
stmt:
theorem exists_plan_attaining_otValue (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) (c : α → β → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1) :
    ∃ π : α → β → ℝ, IsTransportPlan p q π ∧ transportCost c π = otValue p q c
proof:
by
  have hcont : Continuous fun π : α → β → ℝ => transportCost c π := by
    simp only [transportCost]
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
      continuous_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
        (continuous_apply₂ a b).mul continuous_const
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hmin⟩ :=
    (isCompact_setOf_isTransportPlan p q).exists_isMinOn
      ⟨fun a b => p a * q b, productPlan_isPlan p q hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1⟩
      hcont.continuousOn
                                               
  have hlow : ∀ z ∈ transportCost c '' {σ : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q σ},
      transportCost c π ≤ z := by
    rintro z ⟨ρ, hρ, hEq⟩
    rw [← hEq]
    exact hmin hρ
  have hmem : transportCost c π ∈ transportCost c ''
      {σ : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q σ} := ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨π, hπ, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  ·                               
    show transportCost c π ≤
      sInf (transportCost c '' {σ : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q σ})
    exact le_csInf ⟨_, hmem⟩ hlow
  ·                               
    show sInf (transportCost c '' {σ : α → β → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q σ})
        ≤ transportCost c π
    exact csInf_le ⟨transportCost c π, hlow⟩ hmem

name: otValue_minimal
doc:
**`otValue` 的最优性（最优化性质）**：取到 `otValue p q c` 的可行计划确是最优的。

证明：`π*` 的代价等于 `otValue`；对任意可行 `π`，
`otValue ≤ transportCost c π`（由 `otValue_le_cost`，需代价非负）即得。
stmt:
theorem otValue_minimal (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) (c : α → β → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1)
    (hc : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ c a b) :
    ∃ πstar : α → β → ℝ, IsTransportPlan p q πstar ∧
      transportCost c πstar = otValue p q c ∧
      ∀ π : α → β → ℝ, IsTransportPlan p q π →
        transportCost c πstar ≤ transportCost c π
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hval⟩ := exists_plan_attaining_otValue p q c hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1
  exact ⟨π, hπ, hval, fun σ hσ => by
    rw [hval]
    exact otValue_le_cost hσ hc⟩

end Lattice

name: rnDerivLog_integral_nonpos
doc:
**RN 层 Gibbs 的方向（正确符号）**：概率测度 `μ, ν`、`ν ≪ μ`、`μ ≪ ν`、
`log(dν/dμ)` 可积 ⟹ `∫ log((ν.rnDeriv μ).toReal) ∂μ ≤ 0`。

**注意**：任务书要求的 `0 ≤ ∫ log(dν/dμ)` 是**假命题**（正确方向为 `≤ 0`），
见 `logRatio_expectation_negative`。

**已无不可证假设**：`ρ = dν/dμ` 的 `μ`-可积性此前作为显式假设 `hintρ` 引入；现由
mathlib 的 `Measure.integrable_toReal_rnDeriv`（`MeasureTheory/Decomposition/Lebesgue.lean:361`，
语句 `Integrable (fun x ↦ (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal) ν`，本处取 `τ := ν`、`υ := μ` 即得
`Integrable (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) μ`，**方向精确匹配**）证出，
**故本定理不再假设 `hintρ`**。

仍保留的假设：`hint`（`log ρ` 的 `μ`-可积性）——mathlib 无 `Integrable.log`（0 附近无界，
故对一般可积函数为假），如实保留。
stmt:
theorem rnDerivLog_integral_nonpos {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ ν : Measure α}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    [ν.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ]
    (hac : ν ≪ μ) (hmut : μ ≪ ν)
    (hint : Integrable (fun x => Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal)) μ) :
    ∫ x, Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) ∂μ ≤ 0
proof:
by
  have hintρ : Integrable (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) μ :=
    Measure.integrable_toReal_rnDeriv
  have hint1 : Integrable (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal - 1) μ :=
    hintρ.sub (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
  have hρ : ∫ x, (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal ∂μ = 1 := by
    rw [Measure.integral_toReal_rnDeriv hac, measure_univ]
    simp
  have hpoint : (fun x => Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal))
      ≤ᵐ[μ] fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal - 1 := by
    filter_upwards [Measure.rnDeriv_pos' hmut, Measure.rnDeriv_ne_top ν μ] with x hx hxtop
    have hx' : (0 : ℝ) < (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.mpr ⟨hx, lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hxtop⟩
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx'
    linarith
  have hzero : (∫ x, ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal - 1) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hintρ (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)), hρ]
    simp
  calc ∫ x, Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) ∂μ
      ≤ ∫ x, ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal - 1) ∂μ := integral_mono_ae hint hint1 hpoint
    _ = 0 := hzero

name: rnDeriv_gibbs
doc:
**Radon–Nikodym 层的 Gibbs 不等式（正确形式，补 RealContinuousKL 的标注缺口）**：
概率 `μ`、`ν ≪ μ`、`ρ = dν/dμ`，且 `ρ·log ρ` 可积 ⟹ `0 ≤ ∫ ρ·log ρ dμ`
（即离散步 KL(ν‖μ) ≥ 0 的 RN 形式）。
证明：逐点 `ρ − 1 ≤ ρ·log ρ`（`sub_le_mul_log_div` 取 `g = 1`）+ `integral_mono`
+ `∫(ρ−1) dμ = 1 − 1 = 0`。

**已无不可证假设**：同定理 1，`ρ` 的 `μ`-可积性由
`Measure.integrable_toReal_rnDeriv`（`Lebesgue.lean:361`，取 `τ := ν`、`υ := μ`）证出，
**故本定理不再假设 `hintρ`**；仅保留 `hint`（`ρ·log ρ` 的 `μ`-可积性）。
stmt:
theorem rnDeriv_gibbs {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ ν : Measure α}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hac : ν ≪ μ)
    (hint : Integrable (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal
      * Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal)) μ) :
    0 ≤ ∫ x, (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal * Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) ∂μ
proof:
by
  have hintρ : Integrable (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) μ :=
    Measure.integrable_toReal_rnDeriv
  have hint1 : Integrable (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal - 1) μ :=
    hintρ.sub (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
  have hρ : ∫ x, (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal ∂μ = 1 := by
    rw [Measure.integral_toReal_rnDeriv hac, measure_univ]
    simp
  have hpoint : (fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal - 1)
      ≤ fun x => (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal * Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) := by
    intro x
    simpa [div_one] using
      sub_le_mul_log_div (ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hzero : (∫ x, ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal - 1) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hintρ (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)), hρ]
    simp
  have hmono : (∫ x, ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal - 1) ∂μ)
      ≤ ∫ x, (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal * Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) ∂μ :=
    integral_mono hint1 hint hpoint
  linarith

name: logRatio_expectation_negative
doc:
**反例（机器验证）**：`½·log(½) + ½·log(3/2) < 0`。

取 `μ = ½δ₀ + ½δ₁`（概率测度）与 `ν = ¼δ₀ + ¾δ₁`（概率测度），
则 `ρ = dν/dμ = (½, 3/2)` 且
`∫ log ρ dμ = ½·log(½) + ½·log(3/2) = ½·log(3/4) < 0`。
这直接否证了「`0 ≤ ∫ log((ν.rnDeriv μ).toReal) dμ`」这一字面命题
（该字面命题**未证**，因为它为假；本文件证明的是正确方向的
`rnDerivLog_integral_nonpos`）。
stmt:
theorem logRatio_expectation_negative :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 / 2) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (3 / 2) < 0
proof:
by
  have h : Real.log ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (3 / 2)) < 0 := by
    rw [Real.log_neg_iff (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 * (3 / 2))]
    norm_num
  have h2 := Real.log_mul (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
    (show (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
  nlinarith [h, h2]

doc: 反例的「乘积形式」：`½·log(3/4) < 0`（等价重述，便于机验）。

name: renyiDivergence_self
doc:
**自散度为零**：`p` 严格正、`Σ p = 1`、`α ≠ 1` ⟹ `D_α(p‖p) = 0`。
证明：`p^α·p^{1−α} = p^{α+(1−α)} = p`（`Real.rpow_add`）+ `log 1 = 0`。
stmt:
theorem renyiDivergence_self {n : ℕ} {α : ℝ} (_hα : α ≠ 1) (p : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hsum : ∑ i, p i = 1) :
    renyiDivergence α p p = 0
proof:
by
  unfold renyiDivergence
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin n, p i ^ α * p i ^ (1 - α) = p i := by
    intro i
    rw [← Real.rpow_add (hp i)]
    have h : α + (1 - α) = 1 := by ring
    rw [h, Real.rpow_one]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [hsum, Real.log_one, mul_zero]

name: renyiDivergence_two_eq
doc:
`α = 2` 时的显式形式：`D_2(p‖q) = log(Σ_i p_i²/q_i)`（`q > 0`）。
（`hq` 保留为定义域标注，当前证明不消耗它。）
stmt:
theorem renyiDivergence_two_eq {n : ℕ} (p q : Fin n → ℝ) (_hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) :
    renyiDivergence 2 p q = Real.log (∑ i, p i ^ 2 / q i)
proof:
by
  unfold renyiDivergence
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin n, p i ^ (2 : ℝ) * q i ^ ((1 : ℝ) - 2) = p i ^ 2 / q i := by
    intro i
    have h2 : (1 : ℝ) - 2 = -1 := by norm_num
    rw [h2, Real.rpow_neg_one, div_eq_mul_inv]
    norm_num
  simp only [hterm]
  norm_num
